title: One-tape machines in coded form
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with exactly one work tape. Then there exists a machine in code normal form such that, for every Boolean input, Boolean output, and time bound, its associated finite machine computes that output from that input within that time bound if and only if $M$ does.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
replaced:
Let $M$ be a machine over the binary alphabet with finitely many states and
exactly one work tape.  Then there exists a machine $M'$ in code normal form
such that for every input string $x$, every output string $w$, and every
time bound $t$, the bundled machine of $M'$ halts on $x$ within $t$ steps
with output $w$ if and only if $M$ does.
